description: The complete Bulgaria income tax computation for 2026, as on the return. Covers: Employee contributions per fund, both 2026 periods of the maximum insurable income, and the employer cost; Employment, civil contracts and freelance income with 25/40/60% statutory expenses and their contributions; Sole trader at 15%, self-insured contributions with optional sickness cover; Rent (10% expenses), property sales with the 3- and 5-year exemptions, shares (regulated-market exemption), crypto; Dividends 5% final, foreign dividends with credit, interest (EU/EEA deposits exempt); and more. Returns the tax, the balance still to pay or to be refunded after taxes already paid, every option the law offers compared, and each step with its legal reference. All amounts in EUR; everything is optional, give only what applies. What is not modelled is listed in the result.

inputSchema.description: An individual's income tax return for Bulgaria, tax year 2026 (calendar year). Every amount is in euros for the whole year; leave out what does not apply.

born_before_1960.description: Born before 1 January 1960 (no second-pillar pension contribution; same total). Default false
